faq: Can AI write a good tracking plan?
It can, but not from a lazy prompt. Asked vaguely, it produces something plausible-looking — which is worse than nothing, because it looks finished.
Why specify the output format first?
Because if you specify the sheet before the task, every event it writes has to fit a structure you chose. Specify the task first and you get prose you then have to reshape.
Why does it need to browse the product?

Because a tracking plan written from a description is a guess. Driving a real browser through your authenticated app is what makes it map what's actually there rather than what a product like yours usually has.
The decisions: which events matter to your business, what counts as activation, and which of the model's suggestions are noise. The AI does the enumeration; you do the judgement.
